$comment: Hero creation data for the character sheet UI (VTTER-47). Source of truth: rules/core-rules.md §3 (making a hero, ancestries, backgrounds, derived numbers), §4 (callings), §5.3 (starting spells), §7.3 (kits). Change both together (see AGENTS.md).

Human.trait: Adaptable: +1 extra skill rank and 1 extra talent at level 1

Stoneborn.trait: Bedrock: once per scene, ignore being knocked prone, pushed, or grabbed. Can see in darkness as if in dim light

Wildkin.trait: Instinct: you can never be surprised. Pick one beast perk: keen nose, claws (d6 unarmed), night eyes, or a +2 bonus to jumping

Emberkin.trait: Inner Flame: resist fire and cold (halve that damage). Once per rest, you can shed light in a 10 m radius or ignite something you touch

Hollowborn.trait: Unliving: don't eat, sleep, or breathe. Immune to poison and disease. Healing magic heals you for half, but repair (a Craft Test during a rest) heals you fully

backgrounds.name: Ash-farmer
backgrounds.contact: A village elder who owes you a favor

backgrounds.name: Forge-scavenger
backgrounds.contact: A fence in the Ruin Market

backgrounds.name: Temple foundling
backgrounds.contact: A priest of the Last Flame

Warden.signatureText: As a Reaction, when an ally within reach is attacked, you take the hit instead and roll your own dodge with a Boon.

talents.name: Taunt
talents.text: One foe must target you on its next turn or take a Bane on every attack.

talents.name: Shield Wall
talents.text: Allies adjacent to you get +1 Dodge.

talents.name: Unbreakable
talents.text: Once per rest, when you'd take a Wound, take it as 5 Grit damage instead.

talents.name: Shove
talents.text: When you hit, also push the target one zone or knock it prone.

talents.name: Sentinel
talents.text: Foes that leave your reach provoke a free attack.

talents.name: Iron Oath
talents.text: +2 Will, immune to fear while your Oath is active.

Blade.signatureText: When you hit with a Strong success, make one extra attack right away (no Momentum needed).

talents.name: Riposte
talents.text: When you dodge an attack with a Strong success, deal your weapon die in damage.

talents.name: Twin Fang
talents.text: Fight with two light weapons and roll both damage dice, keep the higher.

talents.name: Blooded
talents.text: +1 weapon die of damage to a foe already below half Grit.

talents.name: Dancer
talents.text: Moving through foes' zones never provokes.

talents.name: Executioner
talents.text: Your critical range is 19–20.

talents.name: Battle Trance
talents.text: For one round, take two Actions.

Blade.kit: Two light weapons or one versatile weapon, light armor

Hexer.signatureText: Casts Arcane spells with Lore. Starts with 3 spells and learns 1 per level.

talents.name: Overchannel
talents.text: Add +1 spell die to a spell, but take a Bane on the cast.

talents.name: Ember Shield
talents.text: +3 Dodge against one attack.

talents.name: Twinned
talents.text: Single-target spells can hit two targets.

talents.name: Quiet Casting
talents.text: Cast without words or gestures.

talents.name: Ward-sense
talents.text: Always sense magic within 10 m.

talents.name: Familiar
talents.text: A small ember-spirit scouts, carries, and can deliver touch spells.

Hexer.kit: A focus (wand or orb), dagger, a spellbook, ink

Mender.signatureText: Casts Divine spells with Spirit. Starts with 3 spells and learns 1 per level. Always has Mend Wounds.

talents.name: Sanctuary
talents.text: Your zone becomes holy ground. Foes there take a Bane until your next turn.

talents.name: Stitch the Soul
talents.text: During a rest, remove 1 extra Wound from one ally.

talents.name: Searing Faith
talents.text: Your melee hits deal +1d4 fire damage.

talents.name: Last Rites
talents.text: An ally about to be taken Down stays at 1 Grit instead.

talents.name: Beacon
talents.text: Shed holy light. Undead and shadow foes take a Bane against you.

talents.name: Shared Burden
talents.text: When you heal someone, you also heal half that amount.

Mender.kit: A mace or staff, shield, medium armor, a holy symbol, bandages (3 uses: +1d6 Grit)

Pathfinder.signatureText: Mark one foe per scene. You get a Boon on all Tests against it and always know where it is.

talents.name: Volley
talents.text: Attack every foe in one zone with a single roll.

talents.name: Trapper
talents.text: During a rest, set 2 traps. Each deals 2d6 and roots its victim in place.

talents.name: Ghost Step
talents.text: Stealth in the wilds always gets a Boon.

talents.name: Animal Companion
talents.text: A hawk, hound, or wolf that acts on your turn.

talents.name: Pinning Shot
talents.text: When you hit, the target's Speed drops to 0 until its next turn.

talents.name: Guide
talents.text: The party never gets lost and gains +1 Supply die step when traveling.

Pathfinder.kit: Bow and 20 arrows, light weapon, light armor, a snare kit

Silvertongue.signatureText: Once per round, when you hit a foe that an ally is next to, or one that hasn't acted yet, add +2d6 damage.

talents.name: Inspire
talents.text: Give an ally a Boon on any Test.

talents.name: Silver Song
talents.text: All allies in your zone recover 1d6 Grit.

talents.name: Cutpurse
talents.text: Sleight Tests to steal or plant items always get a Boon.

talents.name: Mockery
talents.text: One foe takes a Bane on its next attack and must target you.

talents.name: A Friend Everywhere
talents.text: In any town, you know someone useful.

talents.name: Vanish
talents.text: Once per scene, after an attack, become hidden if any cover is nearby.

Silvertongue.kit: Light weapon, light armor, a disguise kit, lockpicks, 1 vial of poison (+1d6, one hit)

Arcane.name: Shatter
Arcane.effect: 2d6 thunder damage to all, objects crack

Arcane.name: Binding Glyph
Arcane.effect: Target cannot move until it passes DC 12 at the end of its turn

Arcane.name: Veil
Arcane.effect: Invisible until you attack or the scene ends

Arcane.name: Mindspike
Arcane.effect: 2d6 psychic damage, target takes a Bane on its next action

Arcane.name: Kindle
Arcane.effect: Light, small flames, warm or chill an object

Divine.name: Radiant Lash
Divine.effect: 1d8 radiant damage. Undead take a Bane next turn

Divine.name: Ward of Flame
Divine.effect: +2 Dodge until the end of the scene

Divine.name: Rekindle
Divine.effect: Revive at half Grit and remove 1 Wound

Divine.name: Calm
Divine.effect: Ends fear or rage. Hostile NPCs stop to talk

Divine.name: Purify
Divine.effect: Cleanse food, water, poison, or disease
